svg.title: I-ITSM | Incident, users and SLA - core domain

g.text: I-ITSM | Incident, users and SLA - core domain
+prioritize(p: Priority, score: double, reason: String, policy: SlaPolicy) : void
+configure(available: boolean, maximum: int, experience: int, skills: Set<Skill>) : void
User is abstract; users.role is the JPA SINGLE_TABLE discriminator.
Administrator is the actual Java class for the ADMIN role.
Incident stores a User reporter: reporting is not restricted to Employee subtypes.
SlaTracking is embedded and owned; skills are shared entities.
SlaPolicy is nullable in the schema; normal creation assigns a policy before commit.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
